title: Nourishing German Potato Bowl
description: A hearty German dish featuring potatoes, vegetables, and a tangy vinaigrette dressing, served in an earthy earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the diced potatoes, sliced carrots, and chopped onions in a large bowl.
Toss the vegetables with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar and remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Transfer the roasted vegetables to an earthenware bowl and drizzle with the vinaigrette dressing.
Sprinkle the minced garlic and chopped parsley over the top of the vegetables.
Serve the Nourishing German Potato Bowl hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
